system.upgrades: Rank 1 Lead Lined. Rank 1 Reinforced. Rank 1 Fitted. Rank 1 Sturdy. (pg 91, built in)
system.description:
(pg 91) Unique Item. This form fitting single piece rubber and cloth jumpsuit is outfitted with biometric sensors with a heat-dissipation gold strip and antenna for health monitoring. Any vault suit functions as cloth armor with a rank 1 Lead Lined upgrade, rank 1 Reinforced upgrade, rank 1 Fitted upgrade, and rank 1 Sturdy upgrade.
Built in, from those four upgrades (pg 57): Radiation DC decreases by 2 (Lead Lined). +1 bonus to DT, already included in the DT above (Reinforced). When you take damage from an area of effect, your DT is doubled (Fitted). You ignore the negative effects of the first 2 levels of decay for the armor (Sturdy).
A Pip-Boy worn with a Vault Suit of no more than five levels of decay heals an additional amount equal to your level whenever you heal hit points (pg 91).
Acquiring any of these items is entirely up to GM’s discretion. If your background’s starting equipment grants you this item, be sure to communicate with your GM that you will start the game with one of these items.
